gloss: to resound, to reverberate, to ring out

definitions.gloss: to resound, to reverberate, to ring out, to echo loudly
definitions.explanation: For a sound to ring out loudly and spread through a space. Often used for bells, alarms, applause, or any resonant sound.

examples.japanese: {鐘|かね}が{鳴|な}り{響|ひび}いた。
{会場|かいじょう}に{拍手|はくしゅ}が{鳴|な}り{響|ひび}いた。
{真夜中|まよなか}に{サイレン|さいれん}が{町中|まちじゅう}に{鳴|な}り{響|ひび}き、{住民|じゅうみん}は{驚|おどろ}いて{目|め}を{覚|さ}ました。
examples.english: In the middle of the night, sirens resounded throughout the town, and residents woke up startled.

notes:
FORMATION: Compound verb from {鳴|な}る (to ring/sound) + {響|ひび}く (to echo). Emphasizes both the production and spread of sound.

TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし}). Takes が particle: {鐘|かね}が{鳴|な}り{響|ひび}く.

CONJUGATION: Godan verb (ka-row): {鳴|な}り{響|ひび}かない, {鳴|な}り{響|ひび}きます, {鳴|な}り{響|ひび}いて.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鐘|かね}/{鈴|すず}が{鳴|な}り{響|ひび}く (bell rings out)
- {拍手|はくしゅ}/{歓声|かんせい}が{鳴|な}り{響|ひび}く (applause/cheers resound)
- {サイレン|さいれん}/{警報|けいほう}が{鳴|な}り{響|ひび}く (siren/alarm blares)

RELATED WORDS:
- {響|ひび}く (to echo, resound)
- {鳴|な}る (to ring, sound)
- {轟|とどろ}く (to roar, thunder - for louder sounds)
